purpose: stream instantiation + determinism check (recorded, reproducible from the seed alone)

permutationReference.reference: seed-stratified sign-flip permutation over per-pair paired differences
algorithm: For each PERMUTATION REPLICA r = 1..100000, in this fixed draw order:
for stratum s = 1..16 (environment index, pairs (s-1)*50+1 .. s*50):
for j = 1..50 (network index within the stratum), in ascending order:
draw u = rng(); if u < 0.5 flip the sign of that pair's paired difference
(equivalently: an independent random sign per pair, which is exact for a
paired design under the sharp null of no arm effect within the pair),
then recompute the stratum-balanced mean paired difference for the contrast.
Statistic: |mean over pairs of the (possibly flipped) paired difference|,
two-sided; p = (1 + #{replicas with |stat| >= |observed|}) / (1 + resamples).
One rng stream per contrast run, seeded makeRng(seed) with seed below, each
contrast (A-D, then A-B, then A-C) consuming a fresh stream in that order.

randomizationProvenance.designDeterminism: seed table, topology stream and parity assignment are closed-form from the protocol formulas; the only drawn quantity is the permutation-reference seed above, drawn once from the single master stream before launch

protocolReadings: §6d writes both '(k mod 5) -> arm A/B/C/D as 0..3, with the 5th block folded into E' and, in §9, 'E is run on 1 in 5 pairs (every pair with pairIndex ≡ 0 (mod 5))'. The parity table is recorded verbatim per pair as nominalParityArm; the operational plan follows the §9/launch rule: arms A-D on every pair, arm E on pairIndex % 5 === 0.
The §6 coverage question for such a large N is stated in the protocol as unchanged: A-D are estimated from all 800 pairs; E is the floor reference on 160 of them.

disclosures.runtimeCoercionTrap: benchmark.js (57 pinned) builds the arm-D edge list with `arm.swapFactor || 10`, so any FALSY swapFactor silently becomes 10. Measured in the 2026-10-09 dry run: with swapFactor 0 the no-op diagnostic arm produced rows byte-identical to arm D's on the same pair. The config therefore uses a negative swapFactor for the no-op arm and keeps this disclosure next to it.
disclosures.retention: Per-job trial rows are gzip-compressed after each job is harvested (lossless; the manifest's trialsSha256 pins the UNCOMPRESSED bytes, and the .jsonl.gz is recorded with its own sha256). Reason: 3,376 arm-runs x ~41 MB of rows would need ~139 GB; the volume has 18 GB free. Compressed retention keeps every row (measured ratio is written into each job's DONE.json) instead of discarding evidence.

physics.lrNote: identical to the pinned Stage-1 config (protocol §2: the config carries the dopamine-gated rate)

armD_noop_topology_diagnostic.swapFactorNote: NEGATIVE on purpose, not 0. The pinned runtime (benchmark.js) builds the arm-D list as `degreeMatchedRandomEdges(circuit, {seed: spec.topologySeed, swapFactor: arm.swapFactor || 10})()` — a literal 0 is FALSY and silently becomes 10, so a `swapFactor: 0` arm is a second arm D, not a no-op (measured: its rows came out byte-identical to arm D's in the 2026-10-09 dry run). A negative value is truthy and makes `attempts = swapFactor * |E|` negative, so the swap loop never executes and the builder returns the REAL edge list unchanged. Proven element-wise by tools/stage2_noop_check.js phase 1 and end to end (rows vs arm A) by its phase 2.

parallel.note: Job plan for tools/stage2_parallel.js: a job is one pair x one arm group. Each pair entry carries its own `groups` (see seedTable.pairs); `armGroups` below is the default for pairs without an explicit plan.

costProjection.note: Per-arm-run wall time is measured on this machine before launch (see the launch record); the pilot's 15 arm-runs took 12.4 h serial (~50 min per connectome arm-run).

estimand.construction: Y_X,r = mean(sortEntropy over post trials of replicate r) - mean(sortEntropy over pre trials of replicate r); TE = mean over pairs of (Y_A,pair - Y_D,pair); seed-paired within every (environmentSeed, networkSeed) cell.

walkWayEntanglementCheck.purpose: Protocol §6d: show that a measured A-D difference cannot be produced by the topological path ('walk-way') machinery itself — i.e. that the no-op topology variant gains nothing against the REAL environment.
walkWayEntanglementCheck.how: Arm-D construction with a negative swapFactor attempts no swap, so the builder returns the REAL edge list and the arm's endpoint must equal Arm A's for the same pair. The arm `armD_noop_topology_diagnostic` is declared above with swapFactor -1 and run on the 16 stratum pairs (`runsNoopDiagnostic`, one per environment stratum). See swapFactorNote on that arm: the pinned runtime cannot express a literal 0 (falsy-zero coercion), which the 2026-10-09 dry run caught by showing the no-op arm's rows were byte-identical to arm D's.
walkWayEntanglementCheck.evaluation: For each diagnostic pair, compare the no-op arm's rows to arm A's field by field (only the `condition` stamp may differ) and its wiring fingerprint against the real list: PASS = exact equality; any difference flags entanglement of the topology path into the environment/network path and voids the A-D interpretation until explained. The two arms run as SEPARATE benchmark invocations, so this simultaneously checks that the runner's job splitting is draw-neutral.
walkWayEntanglementCheck.wiring: no runtime change required: it reuses the pinned Arm-D builder through the pinned `customEdges` hook, so no §13-pinned file is touched.
walkWayEntanglementCheck.verificationBeforeLaunch: tools/stage2_noop_check.js — compares the swapFactor-0 edge list against the real list (counts, in/out-degree sequences, weight/sign multiset, fingerprint) before any launch.

seedTable.note: Protocol §6d fixed table. environmentSeed = 4101 + (envIndex-1)*101 (16 strata); networkSeed = 9201 + (netIndex-1)*101 (50 per stratum); topologySeed = 7008 + k (the 7000+ stream continued AFTER the §6c reserve 7001-7008, so no pre-drawn/pilot topology seed is consumed). Arm A-D on EVERY pair; arm E on pairIndex % 5 === 0; the no-op topology diagnostic on the 16 stratum pairs (networkIndex 5).
